summary: Ran the full harness setup flow on the fresh Chalk clone: installed the local harness core, verified `harness doctor`, produced a skill-driven harnessability assessment with final grade B and a B/B two-axis tuple, hand-wrote the required BIO governance doc from the template, scaffolded the boot extension with `harness new boot --wrap "npm test"`, verified `boot` in doctor/help and executed `harness boot --json` successfully against `npm test`, then scaffolded and filled a retro record through `harness record retro`.
harnessDoctorNotes: The post-install and final doctor runs reported degraded because the consumer clone lacks `harness/cli/dist`; extensions and record types loaded, so this was treated as the known consumer-mode wart rather than an install failure.

bootResult.observedTests: 32 AVA tests passed; c8 coverage and tsd completed under npm test.

retrospective.workedWell: Repo-local skill resolution worked through `.minih.json`, local package installation with `--prefix` kept dependencies inside the clone, `harness new --wrap` produced a loadable boot extension, and `harness record retro --json` returned a deterministic retro path.
retrospective.confusing: `harness doctor` reports a degraded `cli-build` layer in package-consumer mode even when the installed `npx harness` works, and the setup flow still requires hand-writing governance because `harness init` is deferred.
retrospective.magicWand: Ship `harness init` so `.harness/engineering-harness.md` can be generated from the BIO template and repo evidence instead of being hand-written during the setup flow.

coordination.notes: No cross-agent coordination was used in this single-shot run.

difficulties.description: `harness doctor --json` in the consumer clone reported degraded `cli-build` because it expected `harness/cli/dist/index.js` in the target repo, even though `npx harness` and extension loading worked.
difficulties.mitigation: Recorded it as the known consumer-mode wart and independently verified install, doctor layers, help, boot execution, and record creation.

difficulties.description: A broad file glob after installing dependencies traversed `node_modules`, timed out, and produced a huge partial result.
difficulties.mitigation: Switched to tracked-file inspection with `git ls-files` and narrow file reads.

difficulties.description: There is no shipped `harness init` writer, so governance had to be hand-written from the BIO template even though the rest of setup is skill-driven.
difficulties.mitigation: Used the governance template and verified all eight required BIO headings in `.harness/engineering-harness.md`.

difficulties.description: `harness new boot --wrap "npm test"` scaffolded a working extension but left a TODO summary and minimal success data, which was too sparse for an observable boot Envelope.
difficulties.mitigation: Kept the scaffolded handler and filled in a real summary, description, command, exit code, proof lane, and output tails.
